# Complete rational leaf table for the main endpoint tilt toll

Each row is a closed interval. The last column is an integer m giving the exact lower bound m/10^6 on the corresponding F row. Every value is reconstructed with outward integer arithmetic from the direct support formula; no floating estimate appears. The analytic neighborhoods of F0 and F1 are proved in the parent manuscript.
